test_name: Physical and Environmental Protection - PE-8 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Benefits-Portal-109
Primary NIST family: Physical and Environmental Protection (PE); evidence focus: PE-8.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: one visitor log entry is missing the host departure acknowledgment. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
